build_dataset_process_languages: build a dataset and process languages with tokenization and train-test-valid splitting
create_language_process: create a Language instance and process JSON files into tokenized train test and valid splits
run_dataset_train_bpe: run dataset BPE training on tokenized files to generate shared subword codes
test_dataset_apply_bpe: test applying BPE tokenization to train test and valid files using learned codes
review_dataset_binarize_for_XLM: review binarizing BPE tokenized files into PyTorch format for XLM model training
